name: Security Audit & Detection Quality Benchmark

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  security-audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        
      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          
      - name: Cache Cargo index
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-index-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          
      - name: Cache Cargo build
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-build-target-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          
      - name: Run fmt check
        run: cargo fmt --check
        
      - name: Run clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
        
      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --lib
        
      - name: Run all tests
        run: cargo test --all
        
      - name: Build release
        run: cargo build --release

  benchmark:
    needs: security-audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        
      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          
      - name: Cache Cargo index
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-index-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          
      - name: Cache Cargo build
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-build-target-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          
      - name: Download benchmark corpus
        run: |
          curl -o benchmark_corpus.json \
            https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ammarion/waf-detector/main/benchmark_corpus.json
          
      - name: Run benchmark
        run: |
          cargo run --bin waf-detector -- --benchmark benchmark_corpus.json
          
      - name: Validate benchmark results
        run: |
          # Check if benchmark produces expected output format
          cargo run --bin waf-detector -- --benchmark benchmark_corpus.json | grep -E "(Precision|Recall|F1|Confusion Matrix)" || exit 1

  security-hardening:
    needs: security-audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        
      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          
      - name: Cache Cargo index
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-index-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          
      - name: Cache Cargo build
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-build-target-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          
      - name: Verify CORS policy
        run: |
          # Check for scoped CORS policy instead of permissive
          grep -r "CorsLayer::permissive" src/ && echo "Found permissive CORS - FAIL" && exit 1 || echo "Scoped CORS policy verified"
          
      - name: Verify API token auth
        run: |
          # Check for WAF_DETECTOR_API_TOKEN usage
          grep -r "WAF_DETECTOR_API_TOKEN" src/ || echo "API token auth not found - FAIL" && exit 1
          
      - name: Verify structured consent validation
        run: |
          # Check for public suffix and private IP validation
          grep -r "public_suffix\|private_ip" src/ || echo "Consent validation not found - FAIL" && exit 1
          
      - name: Verify DNS rebinding protection
        run: |
          # Check for resolved IP pinning
          grep -r "resolved_ip\|ip_pinning" src/ || echo "DNS rebinding protection not found - FAIL" && exit 1

  va2-maturity:
    needs: security-audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        
      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          
      - name: Cache Cargo index
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-index-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          
      - name: Cache Cargo build
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-build-target-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          
      - name: Verify content-length delta
        run: |
          # Check for symmetric content-length delta implementation
          grep -r "content_length_delta\|symmetric_delta" src/ || echo "Content-length delta not implemented - FAIL" && exit 1
          
      - name: Verify challenge taxonomy
        run: |
          # Check for ChallengeType enum
          grep -r "ChallengeType" src/ || echo "Challenge taxonomy not found - FAIL" && exit 1
          
      - name: Verify async VA2 endpoints
        run: |
          # Check for VA2 job endpoints
          grep -r "/api/virtual-adversary2/" src/ || echo "VA2 endpoints not found - FAIL" && exit 1

  trust-productization:
    needs: security-audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        
      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          
      - name: Cache Cargo index
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-index-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          
      - name: Cache Cargo build
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-build-target-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          
      - name: Verify SecurityPosture metadata
        run: |
          # Check for SecurityPosture in detection results
          grep -r "SecurityPosture" src/ || echo "SecurityPosture metadata not found - FAIL" && exit 1
          
      - name: Verify deterministic VaReplayBundle
        run: |
          # Check for MD5 integrity hash
          grep -r "MD5\|integrity_hash" src/ || echo "Deterministic bundle not found - FAIL" && exit 1
          
      - name: Verify prod mode enforcement
        run: |
          # Check for WAF_DETECTOR_MODE=prod enforcement
          grep -r "WAF_DETECTOR_MODE.*prod" src/ || echo "Prod mode enforcement not found - FAIL" && exit 1

  final-validation:
    needs: [security-audit, benchmark, security-hardening, va2-maturity, trust-productization]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Final validation
        run: |
          echo "All security audit phases completed successfully"
          echo "✓ Safety Hardening implemented"
          echo "✓ Detection Quality enhanced"
          echo "✓ VA2 Maturity achieved"
          echo "✓ Trust & Productization enabled"
